name: documentation
description: Search documentation resources for the given search query, returning the URIs of the resources that match the search criteria sorted by relevance. This tool can help to get context for any VictoriaLogs related question.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return
limit.title: Maximum number of results

query.description: Query for search (for example, list of keywords)
query.title: Search query

name: facets
description: The most frequent values per each log field seen in the logs returned by the given <query> on the given [<start> ... <end>] time range. This tool uses `/select/logsql/facets` endpoint of VictoriaLogs API.

end.description: End timestamp in RFC3339 format. For example, 2023-10-01T00:00:00Z
end.title: End timestamp

keep_const_fields.description: By default the facets tool doesn’t return log fields, which contain the same constant value across all the logs matching the given query. Add keep_const_fields=true arg if you need such log fields
keep_const_fields.title: Keep constant fields

limit.description: The number of values per each log field can be controlled via limit arg.
limit.title: Limit

max_value_len.description: The facets tool ignores log fields, which contain too long values. The limit on the per-field value length can be controlled via max_value_len arg.
max_value_len.title: Max value length

max_values_per_field.description: The facets tool ignores log fields, which contain too big number of unique values, since they can consume a lot of RAM to track. The limit on the number of unique values per each log field can be controlled via max_values_per_field arg.
max_values_per_field.title: Max values per field

query.description: LogsQL expression for the query of the logs data
query.title: LogsQL expression

start.description: Start timestamp in RFC3339 format. For example, 2023-10-01T00:00:00Z
start.title: Start timestamp

tenant.description: Name of the tenant for which the data will be displayed (format AccountID:ProjectID)
tenant.title: Tenant name (Account ID and Project ID)

name: field_names
description: Get field names from results of the given <query> on the given [<start> ... <end>] time range. The response also contains the number of log results per every field name. This tool uses `/select/logsql/field_names` endpoint of VictoriaLogs API.

end.description: End timestamp in RFC3339. If <end> is missing, then it equals to the maximum timestamp across logs stored in VictoriaLogs.
end.title: End timestamp

query.description: LogsQL expression for the query of the logs streams
query.title: LogsQL expression

tenant.description: Name of the tenant for which the data will be displayed (format AccountID:ProjectID)
tenant.title: Tenant name (Account ID and Project ID)

name: field_values
description: Get unique values for the given <fieldName> field from results of the given <query> on the given [<start> ... <end>] time range. The response also contains the number of log results per every field value. This tool uses `/select/logsql/field_values` endpoint of VictoriaLogs API.

end.description: End timestamp in RFC3339. If <end> is missing, then it equals to the maximum timestamp across logs stored in VictoriaLogs.
end.title: End timestamp

field.description: Field name of for getting field values.
field.title: Field name

limit.description: The maximum number of returned values.
limit.title: Limit of values

query.description: LogsQL expression for the query of the logs streams
query.title: LogsQL expression

tenant.description: Name of the tenant for which the data will be displayed (format AccountID:ProjectID)
tenant.title: Tenant name (Account ID and Project ID)

name: flags
description: List of non-default flags (parameters) of the VictoriaLogs instance. This tools uses `/flags` endpoint of VictoriaLogs API.

name: hits
description: The number of matching log entries for the given <query> on the given [<start> ... <end>] time range grouped by <step> buckets. The returned results are sorted by time. This tool uses `/select/logsql/hits` endpoint of VictoriaLogs API.

end.description: End timestamp in RFC3339 format. For example, 2023-10-01T00:00:00Z
end.title: End timestamp

field.description: Additionally, any number of field=<field_name> args can be passed to /select/logsql/hits for grouping hits buckets by the mentioned <field_name> fields. The grouped fields are put inside 'fields' object of response.
field.title: Field

fields_limit.description: Optional fields_limit=N query arg can be passed for limiting the number of unique 'fields' groups to return to N. If more than N unique 'fields' groups is found, then top N 'fields' groups with the maximum number of 'total' hits are returned. The remaining hits are returned in 'fields': {} group.
fields_limit.title: fields_limit

query.description: LogsQL expression for the query of the logs data
query.title: LogsQL expression

start.description: Start timestamp in RFC3339 format. For example, 2023-10-01T00:00:00Z
start.title: Start timestamp

step.description: The step is used to group the log entries by time. For example, 60s means that the log entries counts will be grouped by 1 minute bucket. Default is 1d.
step.title: Step

tenant.description: Name of the tenant for which the data will be displayed (format AccountID:ProjectID)
tenant.title: Tenant name (Account ID and Project ID)

name: query
description: Executes LogsQL query expression to search log entries. This tool uses `/select/logsql/query` endpoint of VictoriaLogs API.

end.description: End timestamp in RFC3339 format. For example, 2023-10-01T00:00:00Z
end.title: End timestamp

limit.title: Limit

timeout.description: Optional query timeout. For example, timeout=5s. Query is canceled when the timeout is reached.
timeout.title: Timeout

name: stats_query
description: Log stats for the given query at the given timestamp (time) in the format compatible with Prometheus querying API. This tool uses `/select/logsql/stats_query` endpoint of VictoriaLogs API.

query.description: LogsQL expression that must contain stats pipe. The calculated stats is converted into metrics with labels from by(...) clause of the | stats by(...) pipe.
query.title: LogsQL expression

tenant.description: Name of the tenant for which the data will be displayed (format AccountID:ProjectID)
tenant.title: Tenant name (Account ID and Project ID)

time.description: Time in RFC3339. If it's missing, then it equals to the current time.
time.title: Query time

name: stats_query_range
description: Log stats for the given query on the given [start ... end] time range with the given step interval. The stats is returned in the format compatible with Prometheus querying API. This tool uses `/select/logsql/stats_query_range` endpoint of VictoriaLogs API.

end.description: End timestamp in RFC3339. If <end> is missing, then it equals to the maximum timestamp across logs stored in VictoriaLogs.
end.title: End timestamp
